item.title: Tallahassee tourism sees boost from major events with more on the way
item.description: From the Savannah Bananas to PBR bull riding, major events are bringing thousands of visitors and millions of dollars to Tallahassee, and leaders say it's just the beginning.

item.title: Wakulla County School Board unanimously denies COAST Charter School's proposed renewal contract
item.description: The Wakulla County School Board unanimously denied COAST Charter School's renewal contract, citing a missing application. The school is now in the appeals process.

item.title: Lowndes County neighbors weigh in as lawmakers discuss Georgia's voting system
item.description: Georgia's paper ballot bill failed by two votes, but a state law banning QR-coded ballots takes effect July 1, keeping the debate alive.
